svg.title: gaoji architecture
svg.desc: Official QQ messages reach the foreground agent, which talks to multiple models and replies through a durable outbox. Long tasks become durable background jobs that run a coding agent inside the conversation's own container. PostgreSQL stores the ledger.

g.text: The front chats. The back works. The boundary holds.
